_source: Static UI keys for the mobile quick-PR screen (route field-pr, pototype/mobile-screens.jsx MFieldQuickPR L429-478). KEYS ONLY — never a translation. MIXED LAYERS (the approvals_inbox / pm_checklist / pm_notes precedent): fields marked dict below are stable ids read with t(); the rest are the Thai phrase that IS the phrases-layer key, read with tp(). ZERO-MINT WHERE POSSIBLE: fieldNo=gl.inbox.colDocNo 'เลขที่เอกสาร' labels a field the PROTOTYPE DOES NOT HAVE — POST /pr requires a client-supplied `no` and there is no issuer endpoint (apps/api/src/routes/doc-numbering.ts L18-19 says issuing-time semantics land with the Phase-2 numbering service), so the requester enters it rather than the app inventing a business identifier the tenant's numbering series owns; the addition is disclosed in BLOCKERS.md B-297 · fieldQty=inv.colQty 'จำนวน' labels the requested quantity · submit=common.submit 'ส่งอนุมัติ' labels the sticky CTA, which performs the REAL POST /pr + POST /pr/{id}/submit; the prototype's own label 'ส่ง PR ด่วน · 82,000 ฿' (L473) is NOT keyed because its money half is a hardcoded amount and money = SERVER (the only amount this screen shows is the one the 201 body states) · submitted=labor.att.savedBadge 'บันทึกแล้ว' and failed=admin.common.actionFailedToast reuse the same generic honest-state copy pm_checkin/pm_checklist/pm_notes borrowed under BLOCKERS.md B-268 (ก) · draftOnly=pr.form.draftSavedToast 'บันทึกร่างแล้ว' is EXACT for the state it names: POST /pr succeeded and POST /pr/{id}/submit did not, so a real PR exists as a draft. That state is surfaced separately ON PURPOSE — reporting it as a plain failure would invite a second attempt which, with no unique index on pr.no (B-295), would really create a duplicate PR · empty=boq.edEmptyRowsFilter 'ไม่พบรายการที่ตรงกับตัวกรอง' for a genuinely empty list (an UNREADABLE list renders an em-dash and no key at all — the two are different states and must stay different). Two phrase slots ALREADY EXIST in the sacred phrases layer and are reused zero-mint: fieldBoq 'เลือกจาก BOQ' (L436) and fieldUrgency 'ความเร่งด่วน' (L450). FOUR values are net-new and are staged in agents/orch-d-recon/field-group-i18n.apply.json for a Wei sacred round (docs/extract/i18n-full.json is untouched by this slice): title 'ขอซื้อด่วน' (L432), sub 'PR ด่วนจากหน้างาน' (L432), fieldItems 'รายการที่ขอซื้อ' (L441), fieldPhotos 'รูปประกอบ + เหตุผล' (L456). Each already resolves in Thai today (tp returns the key for lang th — the merged-screen precedent) and lights up en/zh/ar once applied. NOT REPRESENTED HERE — the approval-chain info card (L464-469, 'ส่ง → หน.จัดซื้อ → ผจก.โครงการ → ผอ.ก่อสร้าง (วงเงิน ≥ 100K)') is DROPPED rather than keyed: the implemented tiers are different numbers entirely (pr.ts B-070 — หน.จัดซื้อ every PR · ผจก.โครงการ > 500,000 · MD > 2,000,000), so rendering it would state something false about the requester's own document. A missing value can be em-dashed; a false claim cannot. The urgency and photos/reason VALUES are likewise not keyed — pr has no urgency, photo or reason column and the app has no upload seam — so those two labels are kept as chrome over an em-dash.
_layers: dict (t): fieldNo · fieldQty · submit · submitted · draftOnly · failed · empty. phrases (tp): title · sub · fieldBoq · fieldItems · fieldUrgency · fieldPhotos.
